problem:
Consider the affine transformation $T,$ defined as

$$
x=u+v-2,\,y=u-3v+1.
$$

What is the area scale factor of the transformation?
worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

Notice that the given transformation can be expressed as

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}u+v-2 \\ u-3v+1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}u+v \\ u-3v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 1 & -3\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the matrix representation of the linear transformation associated with $T$ is $A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 1 & -3\end{aligned}].$

Computing the determinant of $A,$ we get

$$
det(A)=|\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 1 & -3\end{aligned}|=1\cdot (-3)-1\cdot 1=-4.
$$

So, the area scale factor of the transformation is

$$
|det(A)|=|-4|=4.
$$
